issues.issue: Population states 'Adults <60 years' but design shows maintenance up to 12 cycles and citation says patients were adults <60; however text says 'median age 47 years' which is supported — no issue there, but the '<60 years' upper bound conflicts with population range 18-60 in citation which is consistent; retained only as the population claim matches. (dismiss)
NCT field text is the literal string 'null' rather than an actual null/empty value or a real NCT number; the citation provided does not contain any NCT identifier.

The card text drops the word 'retrospectively' from the citation ('verified retrospectively'), overstating the companion diagnostic as prospective selection when the trial used retrospective verification.

Orphan designation citation only supports mastocytosis (4/2010); the added claim 'the application has orphan drug designation' generalizes beyond the mastocytosis-specific grant and the second quote only shows an exemption, not a new grant.

Summary asserts RYDAPT 'qualified for rolling review' and 'response results in advanced SM' support approval, but the cited quotes only mention rolling review grant and 'full approval'; the SM response-results basis is not supported by any cited efficacy numbers.

Advanced SM common ARs are truncated to 'nausea, vomiting, and diarrhea' while the citation lists many more (edema, musculoskeletal pain, abdominal pain, fatigue, URI, constipation, pyrexia, headache, dyspnea); partial listing understates the safety profile.
